name: Sammun
description: Sammun was a planet in the Outer Rim's Batonn sector that was governed by Governor Estorn. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Commander Karyn Faro was tasked with taking the Ninety-Sixth Task Force to Sammun and eliminating local insurgents.
